# Hi, I'm Yihui

I am a student at Columbia University, Mailman School of Public Health.

This website introduces my academic background, professional experience,
and data visualization projects.

## About me
My background combines quantitative training with internship experience in consulting and the pharmaceutical industry. I have worked on projects involving healthcare data analysis, pharmaceutical research workflows, and data visualization.

I am interested in applying statistical methods to healthcare and business questions. I use R and Python for data analysis, and this website shares my academic background, professional experience, and selected projects.
